findings.title: Transit Gateway route table propagation enabled
findings.description: Transit Gateway route table propagation automatically spreads routes from attachments, which can unintentionally expose VPCs to each other. Review each aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation and disable it where cross-VPC routing is not required.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
